records.title: Scholarship for Outstanding Performance (HKSAR Government Scholarship Fund)
records.description: provides scholarships/awards to outstanding local and non-local students pursuing full-time publicly-funded programmes at sub-degree or above levels in the eight University Grants Committee-funded universities, the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, and the Vocational Training Council. One of the scholarships offered under the above fund to non-local students pursuing degree and above level programmes is the Scholarship for Outstanding Performance, which is HK$80,000 (approximately US$10,300) per year.

records.title: Outstanding Performance Scholarship (Self-financing Post-secondary Education Fund)
records.description: provides scholarships to outstanding local and non-local students pursuing full-time locally-accredited self-financing sub-degree or bachelor’s degree programmes. The scholarship is HK$80,000 (approximately US$10,300) per year for non-local undergraduate recipients of Outstanding Performance Scholarship.

records.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
records.fund_title: The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
records.description: aims to attract the best and brightest students from around the world to pursue PhD programmes in Hong Kong. In the 2026/27 academic year, the Fellowship Scheme provides an annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) and a conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) per year for each awardee for a period of three years. For awardees who need more than three years to complete the PhD degree, additional support may be provided by the chosen universities.
